svg.text: Two instruments over one British person in Malta
SI 1995 No. 763. HMRC records one phrase omitted from the published text
Synthesised text with the MLI is published on gov.uk
1 April 1996 UK corporation tax, 6 April 1996 income and capital gains tax
In force 1 October 2018 for the UK, 1 April 2019 for Malta
What it added is a principal purpose test, under MLI article 7
The MLI reached this convention in 2020 and left articles 4, 18 and 23 alone.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 9 September 2026
